title: 第7章 收服天梦冰蚕，偶遇唐门唐雅与贝贝
slug: 斗罗千仞雪穿绝世重振武魂殿
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“考虑清楚了？自愿做我徒儿的智慧魂环？还是......”

“智慧魂环，大佬，我自愿做您徒弟的智慧魂环！！！“

天梦冰蚕生怕自己说晚了，对方手中的剑就当头劈下，那可就玩笑大了。

眼前的女子看起来只是一个93级封号斗罗，可是给它的感觉太可怕了，天梦相信自己的直觉，这是它作为精神系魂兽的最大保命底牌，所以眼前的女子绝对不能小看！

因此天梦冰蚕选择滑跪，再说本来它的目标也是身边这个少年，想以此逃脱帝天等兽的追捕。

“行，算你识时务，开始吧！”

千仞雪收回自己的剑，将其插入剑鞘，随后撑着剑用眼神示意它快点。

天梦冰蚕对此委屈地扁了扁嘴，照做。

“老师？”

“雨浩不用担心，这个冰蚕作为百万年魂兽既然甘愿做你的智慧魂环，又与你同为精神系，对你来说好处多多，你还赚大了。当然，你若不同意的话，这个虫子.......”

“我同意！老师，是不是让它做了我的智慧魂环之后，我就能变得更强了？“

“当然。百万年魂兽做第一环，可以说前所未见，即使现在你很弱，可能需要这个冰蚕暂时封存自己大部分力量，但那也不是普通年限的魂环所能比拟的。更别说你们的属性还很合。”

对于位面之子，千仞雪的耐心都很足，所以解释得很细，霍雨浩听完眼神熠熠生辉。

“那还等什么，冰蚕前辈拜托您了！”

“什么冰蚕前辈好难听，我叫天梦冰蚕，叫我天梦哥就行了。”

“好的，天梦哥，拜托你了！”

“没问题，交给哥，走你！”

话毕千仞雪亲眼见证天梦冰蚕巨大的身躯变小随后化作一道金光径直冲向霍雨浩的精神之海中，然后霍雨浩就这样晕了过去。

对此千仞雪则是依旧安静护法的同时，用精神力锁定霍雨浩，以防发生意外。

好在这个自称天梦冰蚕的魂兽很识相，很快便与霍雨浩融合完毕。

这让千仞雪微蹙的双眉稍稍舒展开了，然而这份平静依旧没有过多久，又是一阵动静传来。

"Have you thought about it carefully? Will you volunteer to be my disciple's wisdom soul ring? Or..."

"Wisdom Soul Ring, big brother, I volunteer to be your apprentice's wisdom soul ring!!!"

Tianmeng Bingcan was afraid that if he said it too late, the sword in the opponent's hand would be chopped off, which would be a big joke.

The woman in front of him looked like just a level 93 Titled Douluo, but the feeling given to it was too terrifying. Tianmeng believed in his intuition. This was its biggest life-saving trump card as a spiritual soul beast, so the woman in front of him must not be underestimated!

Therefore, Tianmeng Ice Silkworm chose to slide and kneel. Besides, its original target was also the young man beside it, hoping to escape the pursuit of Ditian and other beasts.

"Okay, I guess you know the current situation, let's get started!"

Qian Renxue took back her sword, inserted it into the scabbard, then propped up the sword and signaled it to hurry up with her eyes.

Tian Meng Bing Silkworm flattened his mouth in grievance and followed the instructions.

"Teacher?"

"Yu Hao, don't worry. As a million-year-old soul beast, this ice silkworm is willing to be your wisdom soul ring and is of the same spiritual type as you. It will be of great benefit to you, and you will make a lot of money. Of course, if you don't agree, this bug..."

"I agree! Teacher, will it make me stronger after it becomes my wisdom soul ring?"

"Of course. It can be said that it is unprecedented for a million-year-old soul beast to be the first ring. Even if you are very weak now, you may need this ice silkworm to temporarily seal up most of your power, but that is not something that an ordinary-year-old soul ring can match. Not to mention that your attributes are very compatible."

Qian Renxue was very patient when it came to children of planes, so she explained in detail. Huo Yuhao's eyes sparkled after hearing this.

"Then what are you waiting for? I'm leaving it to you, Senior Ice Silkworm!"

"Senior Bingshen is so ugly. My name is Tianmeng Bingshen. Just call me Brother Tianmeng."

"Okay, Brother Tianmeng, please!"

"No problem, leave it to brother, let's go!"

After saying that, Qian Renxue witnessed with her own eyes the huge body of Tianmeng Ice Silkworm, which then turned into a ray of golden light and rushed directly into Huo Yuhao's spiritual sea, and then Huo Yuhao fainted.

Qian Renxue, on the other hand, while still protecting the law quietly, locked Huo Yuhao with her mental power to prevent any accidents.

Fortunately, this soul beast who called himself Tianmeng Iceworm was very knowledgeable and quickly integrated with Huo Yuhao.

This made Qian Renxue's slightly frowning eyebrows relax slightly. However, this calmness did not last long before another burst of movement came.
